name: Shield Broker
oracle_text: When this creature enters, put a shield counter on target noncommander creature you don't control. You gain control of that creature for as long as it has a shield counter on it. (If it would be dealt damage or destroyed, remove a shield counter from it instead.)
blocked_sentences: You gain control of that creature for as long as it has a shield counter on it.

needs.what: a gain_control duration bound to a counter on the stolen permanent: control lasts for as long as that permanent has at least one counter of a named kind (here shield), and is handed back the moment the last such counter is removed (e.g. by the shield counter's own damage/destroy replacement), like `{"op": "gain_control", "duration": "while_has_counter", "counter": "shield"}`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: gain_control's duration is closed to CONTROL_DURATIONS (permanent, until_end_of_turn, end_of_your_next_turn, as_long_as_you_control_source); none ends on counter removal. 'permanent' would be a strictly stronger steal. The counter-bound end exists only for cant_attack_player's `counter` key (the vow-counter attack mark), not for control changes
